correctness.rationale: For generic interior points each side foot and vertex normal-cone foot is counted by the signs of exactly two directed incidences. No two incidence negatives share a side or vertex inside the hexagon. The six distinct incidence lines each appear twice, and their outward caps are six triangles of area 1/6 with precisely six pair intersections of area 1/18 and no positive-area triple intersection. Inclusion plus expectation yields each of k=0,1,2 with probability 1/3, hence N=12-4k uniformly on {4,8,12}; exact rational clipping verifies all 13 chambers and both moments.
